systems.owner: Ministério da Administração Interna / Polícia Nacional; financed by China as non-reimbursable assistance (about EUR 9.3 million for phase 3)
systems.tiers: command centres and video surveillance in Praia and Mindelo; phase 3 adds command centres, data centres and wireless base stations in Assomada, Tarrafal de Santiago and Porto Novo

note: Video surveillance and command centres only; the minister says they let the Polícia Nacional follow occurrences in real time, but no station record system is described.
